scope: In-memory two staged files under actual public ESLint rules; no public files or build

messages.message: React Hook useLayoutEffect has a missing dependency: 'props'. Either include it or remove the dependency array. However, 'props' will change when *any* prop changes, so the preferred fix is to destructure the 'props' object outside of the useLayoutEffect call and refer to those specific props inside useLayoutEffect.

suggestions.desc: Update the dependencies array to be: [basis, props, props.onChange]
